blocking_analysis.question: SLM-blocking across 6-head groups (K/V read once, group-of-6 + barriers + local args)?
blocking_analysis.math: traffic is ~2% of kernel time (100MB in 9.76ms = 10GB/s effective); a 6x traffic cut saves ~0.2ms of 9.76ms. NOT the bottleneck.
blocking_analysis.real_limits: O(T) exact scan at ~2.5ns/op instruction-dense + 24-WI occupancy on 160 EUs. 64K dense decode needs a tiled rewrite (new kernel+harness), explicitly queued, not started.
blocking_analysis.decision: NO SLM-blocking (measured, would not pay); micro-opts kept; roofline path documented
